architectureContext.effectOfThisAnalysis: Earlier decisions retained; no additional relaxed mechanism criterion.

bootstrap.method: Whole games with replacement within old/new holdout strata; fixed stratum sizes; all four models share draws; ratios of summed counts.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile; pointwise, not simultaneous across actions or random seeds.

limitations: All four fixed step5000 endpoints and both paired seeds retained; no checkpoint/bias/seed selection.
Full quality requires both original screens and all original support checks on full nested fit and fresh holdout.
Strict user target >75 is separate from the unchanged preservation guard >=75.
oldFitMonitor and newFitMonitor are diagnostic only, excluded from bootstrap and every quality check.
Added monitor is trained by treatment only; it is not an independent paired generalization result.
New pool natural frequencies update the mixed objective; fixed budget lowers average exposure per window.
No full-fit kan margin diagnostic is required or used by this stage.
Current controls were rejected previously; this stage does not overwrite historical formal 3p/4p acceptance.
Model bytes are checked by the bound evaluator; this analyzer only checks their metadata descriptors.
